summary.text: Samantha Fett is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 22, who took office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Stan Gustafson, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. Her career experience is in marketing.

paragraphs.text: Samantha Fett earned a bachelor's degree from Drake University in 2001, and her career experience includes working in marketing.
For 2025-2026 she is vice chair of the House Education Committee and serves on the Agriculture and Judiciary committees.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Rory Taylor in the general election.
